description: This file contains generated code for Redis grain directory options, validator, and implementation classes, as well as extension methods for configuring Redis-based grain directory in Orleans.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Redis grain directory, including connection configuration and multiplexing.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implements grain directory using Redis as backend, supporting lookup, registration, and unregistration of grain addresses.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Creates the default Redis connection multiplexer based on options.

methods.name: RedisGrainDirectory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Redis grain directory with options, cluster info, and logger.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Redis grain directory asynchronously.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, with optional previous address override.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Unregisters all grain addresses associated with specified silo addresses.
